outcome: Illness requiring hospitalisation between birth and six weeks' age
Death between birth and six weeks' age
Composite adverse infant health outcome (being unwell or dead)
cohort: Neonates born at Mbarara Regional Referral Hospital in Uganda to mothers, followed longitudinally through early infancy.
finding: Maternal abnormal temperature was not significantly associated with the composite adverse infant health outcome (being unwell or dead) between birth and six weeks' age.
